description: This file defines a Dagger Hilt module for integrating JankStats performance monitoring into an Android app, specifically for activities. It provides dependencies such as an OnFrameListener that logs janky frames, the activity window, and a JankStats instance configured to track frames for performance analysis.

classes.name: JankStatsModule
classes.description: A Kotlin object annotated as a Dagger module that provides dependencies related to tracking jank performance in an Android activity.

methods.name: providesOnFrameListener
methods.description: Provides an OnFrameListener that logs frames identified as janky.

methods.name: providesWindow
methods.description: Provides the Window object from the given Activity.

methods.name: providesJankStats
methods.description: Provides a JankStats instance configured to track frame performance on the provided Window with a specified frame listener.
